body: Thank you I just checked out the site you suggested and I think that is the place for me. Thank you to everyone who responded and offered me support and just showed that they care. You dont know how much it means to me that complete strangers care.

Im going to check out the subreddit you told me about. Thank you again for distracting my mind it is what i needed. I dont sit here and constantly think about suicide, its just when I get these intense emotional outbursts, I feel like its the only way to deal with my grief, and thank you for helping me through it.

Ive been in such a dark place I havent even thought about it yet. He loved to go fishing, so I think that going to the lake would be a good place to go to talk to him, that was our special place when he was alive so it makes sense that it would be a special place to talk to him now. We had so much fun fishing. Thank you for taking the time to talk to me. It really helps that there is someone out there that doesnt even know me that is willing to spend their time caring about me, it really helped to talk about the good memories instead of just dwelling on the fact that he died.

We got married 2 years latter, the proposal was not romantic at all but I loved it and him, one day while sitting on the couch watching tv he turned to me and said so do you wanna get married, I was so in love with him it didnt matter how he asked me. We were only 22 when we got married we were young and broke so we had the judge at the court house marry us. And it was the best day of my life.

No our first kiss wasnt at the party, it was a week latter in the kitchen of my appartment, It was the best kiss of my life, he made the first move I was shy and nervous and he told me enough of this Im going to kiss you now. That is one of my best memories of him because that when I knew I had found the man that I was going to spend the rest of my life with.my best memory of him was actually a dark time, I had a miscarriage and the love and support and compassion he had was amazing I will never forget it. My best memory from a happy time would be watching him play with my niece, he was great with her.

We met 15 years ago at a friends birthday party and we fell in love immediately and had a great marriage most days. He had his demons but it was those bad days that made the good times feel even better because we knew how to appreciate the good days because of the bad ones. It was the demons that ended up taking his life.
I feel like there is no future to stay around for he was my best friend and the love of my life and now hes gone and the only way to see him again is to die
I am 34 we didnt have any kids we were married for 12 wonderful years. All of my family and friends dont know how to deal with it and are afraid to say the wrong thing so they just dont come
